verdict.rationale: A guided first-time setup walkthrough is a fair onboarding question for a project-management SaaS like Basecamp, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes adding tools and inviting people, plus reusable project templates. These are adjacent setup features, not a documented guided walkthrough or onboarding tour.
